component.name: ProbeScene
component.script:
' Cases: G (flat MarkupGrid, 3x2 window over 30 items), S (MarkupGrid with two sections), L (MarkupList, which ' does not document `index`). Each scrolls with Down so recycled item components show. sub init() m.seq = 0 m.list = invalid m.global.addFields({ serial: 0, probeCase: "" }) m.timer = m.top.findNode("stepTimer") m.timer.observeField("fire", "runSteps") downs = [] for i = 1 to 4 downs.push({ op: "key", key: "Down" }) end for m.steps = [] for each kase in ["G", "S", "L"] m.steps.push({ op: "create", kase: kase }) m.steps.push({ op: "wait", secs: 2 }) m.steps.push({ op: "mark", phase: "idle" }) m.steps.append(downs) m.steps.push({ op: "mark", phase: "down" }) end for m.steps.push({ op: "done" }) m.timer.duration = 1 m.timer.control = "start" end sub
sub rec(phase as string, kase as string, body as string) m.seq = m.seq + 1 s = m.seq.toStr() while len(s) < 3 s = "0" + s end while print "PROBE|" + s + "|" + phase + "|" + kase + "|" + body end sub
sub runSteps() while m.steps.count() > 0 s = m.steps.shift() if s.op = "create" createList(s.kase) else if s.op = "wait" m.timer.duration = s.secs m.timer.control = "start" return else if s.op = "key" rec("await", s.key, "case=" + m.global.probeCase) m.timer.duration = 2 m.timer.control = "start" return else if s.op = "mark" rec(s.phase, m.global.probeCase, "itemFocused=" + m.list.itemFocused.toStr() + " serial=" + m.global.serial.toStr()) else if s.op = "done" rec("done", "end", "serial=" + m.global.serial.toStr()) m.top.probeExit = true return end if end while end sub
sub createList(kase as string) if m.list <> invalid then m.top.removeChild(m.list) m.global.probeCase = kase root = CreateObject("roSGNode", "ContentNode") if kase = "S" for sec = 0 to 1 section = root.createChild("ContentNode") section.contentType = "SECTION" section.title = "Section " + sec.toStr() for i = 0 to 3 item = section.createChild("ContentNode") item.title = kase + sec.toStr() + "." + i.toStr() end for end for else for i = 0 to 29 item = root.createChild("ContentNode") item.title = kase + i.toStr() end for end if if kase = "L" l = CreateObject("roSGNode", "MarkupList") l.itemSize = [600, 120] l.itemSpacing = [0, 20] l.numRows = 3 else l = CreateObject("roSGNode", "MarkupGrid") l.itemSize = [300, 150] l.itemSpacing = [20, 20] l.numColumns = 3 l.numRows = 2 end if m.list = l l.translation = [100, 160] l.itemComponentName = "IndexItem" l.content = root m.top.appendChild(l) l.setFocus(true) rec("create", kase, "subtype=" + l.subtype()) end sub
